lines:
Separate, low-priority topic split out of #172. Later feature.

## Goal

Define, in Adashi design, how **app-like UI extensions** work: plugins that can contribute user interface (panels, views, dialogs, custom tool result rendering), not just tools.

## To decide and record

- What UI an extension may contribute and where it may render (workbench panel, chat-adjacent, settings, tool result).
- Host API/surface exposed to extension UI and how it is versioned.
- Isolation model: webview sandbox, CSP, origin/permission model, what the UI can and cannot reach (no direct broker/secrets).
- Packaging, discovery, enablement, versioning and trust consistent with the tool-plugin work in #172.
- Permission/consent UX for UI that can act on the user's behalf.
- Failure/degraded behavior and safe disable/removal.
- Relationship to the MCP Apps / UI-resource direction (an MCP server returning UI) versus Aworkit-native UI contributions.

## Relationship

Lowest priority; depends on the plugin packaging/trust model from #172.

data.title: Design app-like UI extensions that contribute interface surface (later feature, low priority)
